day_local: uMvulo weveki yamashumi amathathu kwixesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo nenceba kaThixo uSomandla kubo bonke abasikhaphelayo namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, usenzele inceba.

psalm_response: Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho uhlala phantsi ekhaya kwakusasa, uthathe ikofu yakhe yasekuseni, ujonge ngaseziko apho izicathulo zakhe zazihlala khona. Ezo zicathulo zisemnyango, azinyakazi. Indlu ithule kakhulu. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayenomdla ongapheliyo kwizinto ezintsha, umfana owayethanda ukuhlala nobawo wakhe ekhomba iinqwelo-moya ezidlulayo esibhakabhakeni, ehleka ngombono wakhe omnandi waloo nqwelo-moya yakhe abayibiza ngelika-'con chim airlines'. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo enkulu, efunda izibalo eziphezulu kwaye ecinga ngendlela yokusebenzisa i-AI neeteknoloji ukwenza ihlabathi libe yindawo engcono. Kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, uBen wayeyisipho esikhulu sothando oluhlambulukileyo.

Masithathe lo mfanekiso namhlanje: umti otyalwe ngasemanzi angenayo, njengoko kutsho iNdumiso yanamhlanje. Umti ofumana ubomi, ovelisa iziqhamo zawo ngexesha lawo, amagqabi awo engaphelfiyo. UBen wayenjalo kumlibe wakhe. Wayengumfana owazisa ubomi, owazisa ukuhluma nokumamatheka kubazali bakhe, uAlan noThao, kunye nomfowabo omncinci uRyan. Umthi omi ecaleni kwamanzi awomileyo uyazi ukuba ufumana phi amandla. UBen wayengumfana owayazi ukuba amandla akhe aphuma kuThixo. Akazange azicingele yedwa; wayenentliziyo eyayicingela abanye.

KwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usikhumbuza esithi: 'Yibani nobubele omnye kumunye, nibe novelwano, nixolelwaniswe njengoko uThixo wanixolelayo kuKristu.' Uphawo lwale nyaniso lubonakala ebomini bukaBen. Khumbula loo mhlaba apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi nanhlanje, wathetha nabazali bakhe ngokunikezela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Wayengayiphulanga loo ngulube, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi. Kodwa loo mnikelo, lowo mnqweno womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango. Wayengumfana owayefuna ukunceda omnye ngaphambi kokuba azicingele yena.

Kodwa ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela enzima kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kukho ubusuku lapho ukungabikho kukaBen kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo entliziyweni yenu. Kukho amaxesha apho imibuzo iza ithi ntsho, apho abazali bezibuza ukuba ngaba baphosile na into ethile. Mamele kakuhle namhlanje, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala kwaphela. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzanga okanye ongazenzanga. Kulo mhlaba, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ezingaziswanga yimpazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu ubona umfazi obunjwe ngumthwalo weminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo, ogobileyo, ongakwaziyo ukuma nqane. UYesu uyambiza, athi: 'Nkazana, ukhululiwe esifweni sakho.' Uyamva uYesu, umkhulula, kwaye umfazi ume ngqo ebulela uThixo. Umholi wesinagoga uyakhalaza kuba uYesu ephilisa ng Sabbath, kodwa uYesu uyamphendula, ebonisa ukuba uthando nenceba zidlula yonke imithetho eyomileyo. Lo mfazi ume ngqo, ubenza bonke abantu bajonge phezulu ngovuyo. Nani, nkosi zam, niza kuma ngqo kwakhona. Iintlungu zizakumisa ngokuqina, hayi namhla, mhlawumbi ngomso, kodwa uThixo akazukushiya ubomi benu bugobile naphakade.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba ukhumbula uBen kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale miqondiso yothando eyayiphakathi kwenu, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Kuzo zonke iintsapho ezibukele zikude, nakubantwana ababandezelekileyo abaphethe imithwalo enzima namhlanje, yazi ukuba uThixo akakho kude. UBen, ngomsebenzi omncane wothando owenziweyo kweli hlabathi — njengamanzi acocekileyo abalekayo kuloo well yaseCà Mau, eyakhiwe ngegama lakhe ukunceda abo baphilayo — ubonisa ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga. Uthando lwakhe luqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwenu, Ben, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. Amen.
petitions: Nkosi, sikhumbule uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasishiyeyo, ukuba baphumle kukhanya kwakho okungunaphakade.
Nkosi, ubaqinele abo bonke abasendlini nabakhala ngosizi, ubaphe ithemba noxolo oludlula konke ukuqonda.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana: Yibani nobubele omnye kumunye, nibe novelwano, nixolelwaniswe njengoko uThixo wanixolelayo kuKristu. Yibani ngabaxelisi bakaThixo, njengabantwana abathandekayo, niphile eluthandweni, njengoko uKristu wasithandayo yena ngokwakhe wazinikela ngenxa yethu njengesibingelelo esinevumba elimnandi kuThixo. Ukuba mbi nokuba yintoni okanye ukungcola okanye ukubawa makungakhankanywa naxa phakathi kwenu, njengoko kufanele abangcwele, kunye namanyala okanye ukuthetha okungenasiphelo okanye okudlayo, okungafanelekayo, kodwa endaweni yoko makube bubulelo. Qiniseka ngoku, ukuba akukho mntu umbi okanye ungcolileyo okanye obawayo, oko kukuthi onqula izithixo, onelifa eBukumkanini bukaKristu nobaThixo. Makungabi namntu ukukhohlisayo ngamazwi angenanto, kuba ngenxa yezi zinto umsindo kaThixo uza kubo abangavumiyo. Ngoko musani ukuzihlanganisa nabo. Kuba nibe ningumnyama ngaphambili, kodwa ngoku ningukukhanya eNkosini. Pfilani njengabantwana bokukhanya.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu. Unenhlanhla umntu ongalandeliyo icebo labangendawo, ongahambiyo endleleni yezoni, ongahlaliyo nabaqadi bentsinyelo; kodwa owonwabelayo umthetho kaNKOSI, ocamngca ngomthetho wakhe imini nobusuku. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu. Unjengomti otyalwe ngasemanzi angenayo, ovelisa iziqhamo zawo ngexesha lawo, namagqabi awo angaphelelwayo. Konke akwenzayo kuyaphumelela. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu. Abanjalo abangendawo, abanjalo; banjengomququ oqhutywa ngumoya. Kuba NKOSI uyayibuka indlela yamalungisa, kodwa indlela yabangendawo iyatshabalala. Ziphatheni njengoThixo njengabantwana bakhe abathandekayo kakhulu.

readings.label: Ivangeli
readings.text: UYesu wayefundisa kwesinagoga ngesabatha. Wayekho apho umfazi owayeneminyaka elishumi nanesibhozo enesifo; wayegobile, engenakukwazi ukuma nqane kwaphela. UYesu akumnqola, wamkhalaza wathi kuye: 'Nkazana, ukhululiwe esifweni sakho.' Wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe, waza ngoko nangoko wema nqane waza wazukisa uThixo. Kodwa umholi wesinagoga, enomsindo wokuba uYesu uphilise ngesabatha, wathi esihweleni ephendula: ' Kukho iintsuku ezintandathu ekumele kusetyenzwe ngazo. Yizani ngazo ezo ntsuku ukuze niphiliswe, hayi ngosuku lwesabatha.' INkosi yamnyathela isithi kuye: 'Abazenzisi! Akukho namnye kuni ovulela inkomo yakhe okanye ebolokotho yakhe esibayeni ngesabatha ayikhokele iye kuseza? Lo nyana ka-Abraham, owayeboshwe nguSathana iminyaka elishumi nanesibhozo ngoku, akwamele ukuba akhululwe ngosuku lwesabatha kule ncamango?' Akuba etshilo oku, bonke abachasi bakhe bathotywa isidima; isizwe sonke savuya ngako konke okuhle okwakwenziwe nguye.

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente eliCilekileyo leAltare. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kweento zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba uze emphefumlweni wam namhlanje. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze entliziyweni yam ngomoya nangenceba. Ndiyakwamkela ngaphakathi kwam njengokuba sele ndikulapha; ndibambene nawe ngokuphelele. Mus' ukuyeka ndize ndahlukane nawe naphezulu. Amen.
closing: Makube noxolo lukaThixo olugqithisa konke ukuqonda olugcina iintliziyo zenu neengqondo zenu kuKristu Yesu. Hamba ngoxolo, uthemba uthando lwakhe.
standing_petitions: Sikhumbule uBen nabo bonke abasishiyeyo, ukuba baphumle kukhanya kukaKristu.
Sikhumbule bonke abasezintlungwini nasosizini, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.
day: Monday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
